## Tables

```{r supp_table, echo=FALSE}
sample_table_df<-
  sample_table %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("SampleID","cruiseID","eventDate","decimalLatitude","decimalLongitude","temp","minimumDepthInMeters","maximumDepthInMeters")) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    SampleID = "Sample ID",
    cruiseID = "Cruise ID",
    eventDate = "Collection Date",
    decimalLatitude = "Latitude (DD)",
    decimalLongitude = "Longitude (DD)",
    temp = md("Temperature (°C)"),
    minimumDepthInMeters = "Min Depth (m)",
    maximumDepthInMeters = "Max Depth (m)") %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_text(weight = "bold", size = "large", align = "center")
    ), locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
   tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_text(weight = "bold", size = "large", align = "center")
    ), locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "all", 
      color = "black", 
      weight = px(1)
    ),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(),
      cells_column_labels(),
      cells_title()
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.color = "black",
    table.border.top.width = px(1),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(1),
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table_body.border.bottom.color = "black"
  )

gtsave(sample_table_df, here("figures", "sample_table.png"))
gtsave(sample_table_df, here("figures", "sample_table.html"))
```

Sequencing results table

```{r seq_table, echo=FALSE}
seq_table_df<-
  sample_table %>% 
  mutate(perc_reads_retained = round((reads_after_qaqc/raw_reads)*100), digit=3) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("SampleID","raw_reads","dada2_input","nonchim","reads_after_qaqc","perc_reads_retained")) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    SampleID = "Sample ID",
    raw_reads = "# raw reads",
    dada2_input = "# reads after Cutadapt",
    nonchim = "# seqs after Dada2",
    reads_after_qaqc = "# of seqs after QAQC",
    perc_reads_retained = "% of raw reads retained") %>%
    # tot_thalass_reads = "# of Thalassiosira reads") %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_text(weight = "bold", size = "large", align = "center")
    ), locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "all", 
      color = "black", 
      weight = px(1)
    ),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(),
      cells_column_labels(),
      cells_title()
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.color = "black",
    table.border.top.width = px(1),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(1),
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table_body.border.bottom.color = "black"
  )

gtsave(seq_table_df, here("figures", "seq_filt_table.png"))
gtsave(seq_table_df, here("figures", "seq_filt_table.html"))
```
